name: toy_consensus_forall-s60-r1
cmd: GDP_ENUM_LOG=1 GDP_INFER_TRACE=2 timeout -s KILL 90 bun research/protocols/run.ts --ms 60000 --only toy_consensus_forall --skip given,broken 2>/tmp/err.log; s=$?; grep -E 'small instance|join (enumerated|end|failed)|enum t. (engine end|set|caller)' /tmp/err.log | cut -c1-160 | tail -c 3000; exit $s
